success_criteria_met.criterion: Reaches 99% test accuracy using less than 50% of baseline's compute-to-threshold
success_criteria_met.evidence: Candidate reached 99.94% test accuracy at epoch 500 (1.766e9 FLOPs). Baseline never reached 99% threshold (final test accuracy 45.3%), so baseline compute_to_threshold is null/infinite. Candidate trivially satisfies the <50% constraint.

success_criteria_met.criterion: Maintains performance across all tested primes without per-prime tuning
success_criteria_met.evidence: Per-prime accuracy: p=5: 100%, p=7: 96%, p=11: 100%, p=13: 100%, p=17: 100%, p=19: 100%, p=23: 100%, p=29: 100%, p=31: 100%. All primes at 96% or above with 8/9 at 100%. Baseline range: 36.6%-61.5%. No per-prime tuning was used.

success_criteria_met.criterion: Achieves higher test accuracy per FLOP than baseline across the full compute budget
success_criteria_met.evidence: Candidate: 0.9994 accuracy / 3.533e10 FLOPs = 2.83e-11 accuracy/FLOP. Baseline: 0.4532 accuracy / 1.216e14 FLOPs = 3.73e-15 accuracy/FLOP. Candidate achieves ~7,590x higher accuracy per FLOP. At every matched epoch checkpoint, candidate accuracy exceeds baseline.

failure_criteria_checked.criterion: Gradient norms exceed 50 for 3 consecutive checkpoints
failure_criteria_checked.evidence: Maximum gradient norm was 26.6 at epoch 1 (initialization). All subsequent checkpoints below 5.0. Maximum post-initialization norm was 4.79 at epoch 7800. Never approaches 50 at any checkpoint.

failure_criteria_checked.criterion: Test accuracy does not exceed 60% after consuming 50% of compute budget
failure_criteria_checked.evidence: Test accuracy exceeded 60% at epoch 200 (86.6% test accuracy, 706.6M FLOPs consumed). This is 2% of total epochs and 2% of total FLOPs used. 50% budget point (epoch 5000) shows 99.88% test accuracy.

failure_criteria_checked.criterion: Loss does not decrease below initial loss after consuming 20% of compute budget
failure_criteria_checked.evidence: Initial loss at epoch 1: 8.096. Loss at epoch 100: 2.034. Loss decreased dramatically within first 1% of training. At 20% of budget (epoch 2000), loss was 0.00575.

gradient_stability.details: Gradient norms follow a healthy decay pattern: 26.6 (epoch 1) -> 2.58 (epoch 100) -> 0.61 (epoch 500) -> 0.006 (epoch 7500). Brief perturbation at epochs 7600-8600 (norms 1.2-4.8) resolved by epoch 9000. Mean norm across all checkpoints: 1.12. No consecutive checkpoints with norms exceeding 50.

training_trajectory.description: Fast monotonic convergence. Test accuracy progression: 3.3% (epoch 1) -> 55.7% (epoch 100) -> 86.6% (epoch 200) -> 92.1% (epoch 300) -> 98.7% (epoch 400) -> 99.94% (epoch 500). Maintained 99.4-100% for remaining 9500 epochs. Loss decreased monotonically from 8.096 to 1.1e-4 with a brief perturbation at epochs 7600-8600 (loss rose to 0.005, then recovered to 1.1e-4 by epoch 9900). No grokking dynamics -- learning was immediate and sustained.

per_prime_uniformity.details: All 9 primes at 96% or above. 8/9 primes at 100%. Lowest: prime 7 at 96%. Standard deviation across primes: 0.013. Baseline per-prime range: 36.6%-61.5% (std dev: 0.076). Candidate uniformity is 5.8x tighter than baseline.

compute_to_threshold_ratio.note: Baseline never reached 99% threshold. Candidate reached it at epoch 500.

gradient_health_mean_norm.note: Candidate has higher mean gradient norm but well within healthy range. Higher norms reflect active learning; baseline's near-zero norms reflect memorization without generalization.

param_efficiency_params_per_accuracy_poi.note: Candidate uses 353 parameters total vs baseline's 405,023. Candidate is 2,531x more parameter-efficient per accuracy point.

diagnostics.convergence_type: Fast monotonic convergence with sustained plateau. Reached 99.94% test accuracy by epoch 500 (5% of total budget). No grokking dynamics -- the architecture exploited mathematical structure immediately. Loss continued decreasing smoothly through epoch 7500, followed by a brief perturbation at epochs 7600-8600 (likely weight decay interaction at near-zero gradient regime) that self-resolved by epoch 9000. Final training is in a stable low-loss regime.

late_perturbation.cause: Weight decay interaction at near-zero gradient magnitudes
late_perturbation.impact: Transient -- model recovered to 100% test accuracy by epoch 9000
